_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the E2E shard plan. Consumed by BOTH .github/workflows/pr.yml (scripts/e2e-shards.sh matrix -> strategy.matrix via fromJSON) and deploy/ci-worker/runci.sh (scripts/e2e-shards.sh list). Every tests/e2e/*.spec.ts MUST be assigned to exactly one shard -- scripts/e2e-shards.sh check enforces this and FAILS CI on drift (an unassigned spec would silently never run; a dead reference would error). key_slot selects the OpenRouter key: a=primary (OPENROUTER_API_KEY / secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY_CI, always present), b/c=optional extra keys that fall back to a when unset, so concurrent LLM shards never share one rate-limit window. port is used ONLY by runci.sh (all shards share one worker machine, so they need distinct ports); each GitHub Actions shard runs on its own runner and always uses 6060. solo=true (optional, runci.sh-only, default false) makes runci.sh drain all in-flight shards and run this one ALONE in the foreground -- for timing-sensitive specs (WS-idle, live-vs-replay DOM fidelity, real-recap latency) that flake under any CPU contention on the shared worker; on GitHub Actions each shard already has its own runner so solo is a no-op there. To add a spec: drop it in tests/e2e/ and add its path to exactly one shard here -- nothing else to touch.

shards._comment: ADR-067 §13.4 isolation matrix. These specs are the ONLY files the isolation-chromium/firefox/webkit projects match, and each runs on all three engines, so this shard needs `playwright install firefox webkit` in addition to chromium -- a chromium-only runner cannot execute it. Its own shard for exactly that reason: the extra engine install is confined here instead of slowing every other shard. key_slot a because nothing here calls an LLM.

ADR-067 §13.4 item 4 / §0. The only two headed cases -- the browser's OWN PDF handling, which headless Chromium does not have. Needs a display (xvfb-run, or GitHub Actions' bundled X server) because playwright.config.ts sets headless:false on the `preview-headed` project. Separate shard so that requirement lands on one job rather than all of them.
